m2Definition.definition: A current complete Poșta Română six-digit postcode assignment and exception denominator is usable under explicit reviewed permission for AGID processing, derivation, storage, redistribution and public serving, and is reconciled to a fixed authoritative Romania postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release. Provider, edition/reference date, licence, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, reviewed transform, topology, coverage, exclusions and reproducible conversion are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. officialObservations.finding: Poșta Română describes its public postcode database as periodically updated and supports address-to-postcode and postcode-to-address search. The current HTML POST contract exposes county, locality, street-and-number, postal-subunit and office context; it does not return a fixed bulk distribution or area geometry.

The operator document defines six numeric digits and examples spanning rural localities, towns, town components, cities over 50,000 residents, county seats and Bucharest. Syntax and category semantics do not provide a current complete assignment denominator or boundary.

Infocod is supplied electronically to a client after a prior written request and updated monthly for the described postal-sorting arrangement. This is controlled assignment access, not an open AGID processing/derivation/redistribution/public-serving licence or postcode-area release.

The operator says it assigns and updates postcodes, records street-level codes for Bucharest, 40 county-seat municipalities excluding Ilfov and six other municipalities, assigns one code to other localities, and says the then-current postcode database lacked GPS coordinates. This is dated negative evidence and may be superseded only by a newer exact release.

The 2025 organization regulation assigns development and updating of the national postal nomenclature/coding and website postcode information to Poșta Română functions. It establishes current organizational responsibility, not a public polygon distribution.

ANCOM Decision 810/2024 treats the postcode system and deliverable-address database as non-physical public-postal-network infrastructure. Third-party postal-provider access is negotiated by civil contract with technical/economic conditions and price. It is not a blanket public redistribution grant.

rightsAssessment.note: Public search availability, a written-request handoff and regulated civil-contract access are not treated as a licence for AGID derivation, redistribution or public serving. This is a conservative engineering gate, not a legal opinion.

blockerSummary: Current Poșta Română evidence establishes six-digit format, periodically updated bidirectional search, controlled Infocod monthly updates, current operator responsibility and contract-based regulated access. It does not establish compatible AGID processing/derivation/storage/redistribution/public-serving permission, a fixed current complete assignment/exception artifact, or an authoritative postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release. The dated operator geography evidence says the database then lacked GPS coordinates; no newer exact area release, digest, topology/coverage audit, complete area/non-area reconciliation or real RO runtime/API/UI artifact was established.
